task_text: Turn off the room light, turn on faucet

central_instructions.R1: Move to the light switch in the bedroom and turn off the light.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the faucet in the bathroom and turn it on.
central_instructions.R3: Assist R1 if needed in turning off the light in the bedroom.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R2 if needed in turning on the faucet in the bathroom.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Move to the light switch in the bedroom. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn off the light switch in the bedroom. (r1_s2)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the faucet. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn on the faucet. (r2_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the light switch. (r2_s3)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn off the room light. (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Move to the light switch in the bedroom. (r3_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom to assist R3. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [ASK_HELP] Request R1 to turn off the light switch. (r3_s2)
- R1 [HELP] Turn off the light switch in the bedroom. (r1_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Move to the faucet in the bedroom. (r3_s3)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Turn on the faucet in the bedroom. (r3_s4)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move to the light switch location. (r4_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the faucet location. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn off the room light. (r4_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Attempt to turn on the faucet. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [ASK_HELP] Request assistance from R4 to turn on the faucet. (r2_s3)
- R4 [HELP] Assist R2 in turning on the faucet. (r4_s3)
